name: CaseForwardAI
tagline: Organises personal-injury case documents, tracks deadlines and drafts client updates for human approval.

awards: Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan

problem: Attorneys handle hundreds of records per case with scattered details and strict deadlines.
solution: Analyses case documents into a dashboard, flags deadlines and gaps, and an assistant drafts emails that a person confirms before sending.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a case and approve a drafted client update.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan” among 112 submissions.
Keeps a human confirmation before actions.

lessons: Answer the sponsor's workflow brief and keep the lawyer in control.
